breaking_news.headline: Pro-Trump Influencer Benny Johnson is being sued for defamation by ICE protesters
breaking_news.summary: The lawsuit says the prominent conservative podcaster falsely claimed the protesters were assaulting ICE officers during demonstrations at an ICE facility in Illinois last year.

breaking_news.headline: Economist Betsey Stevenson breaks down the gender gap in recent hiring reports
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. economy added fewer jobs than expected last month and unemployment ticked up to 4.2%. NPR's Scott Simon talks to Betsey Stevenson, an economist at the University of Michigan.

breaking_news.headline: She died covering war for Fox News. Her parents blame the network — and a star reporter
breaking_news.summary: The family members of two Fox News journalists killed while covering the war in Ukraine are suing the network, saying it put getting the story ahead of its people.

breaking_news.headline: G7 countries reluctantly agree to tap their fuel reserves to help the U.S.
breaking_news.summary: G7 nations plan to release large amounts of diesel fuel soon, but European countries were not entirely happy about the agreement.

breaking_news.headline: New Hollywood era begins with an epic mega merger between Paramount and Warner Bros.
breaking_news.summary: The Paramount and Warner Bros. merger has survived court challenges, public protests and regulatory scrutiny. Now, the Hollywood heavyweight, named Skydance, begins operating.

breaking_news.headline: Disney, ABC battle Trump's FCC in court over free speech protections
breaking_news.summary: President Trump has repeatedly called for Disney's ABC to fire late night comedian Jimmy Kimmel, for mocking him. Trump has also routinely denounced ABC's The View, accusing it of being unfair.

breaking_news.headline: As Taiwan expands Arizona chip plant, China warns against developing political ties
breaking_news.summary: The world's biggest chipmaker now manufactures at scale in Phoenix, as well as Taiwan. China is warning political leaders in Arizona to not get too friendly.

breaking_news.headline: What voters in 6 key states could tell us about the 2026 midterms
breaking_news.summary: Morning Edition is heading to Maine, Texas, North Carolina, Georgia, Ohio and Michigan to hear what voters say is shaping their choices ahead of the midterm elections.

breaking_news.headline: AfD candidate elected speaker of German regional parliament for first time
breaking_news.summary: Although Tobias Rausch's role is largely symbolic, opponents have described the result as a watershed moment.

breaking_news.headline: Fort Hood shooter to be executed by firing squad - a first for US military since World War Two
breaking_news.summary: Nidal Malik Hasan killed 13 unarmed soldiers and injured another 32 in the deadliest ever non-combat attack on an American military base.

breaking_news.headline: Kenya confirms its first Ebola death as outbreak spreads
breaking_news.summary: The patient had been living in DR Congo, where more than 4,000 people have died from the disease this year.

breaking_news.headline: 'Ghost particles' from space telescope wins physics Nobel
breaking_news.summary: Belgian physicist Prof Francis Halzen has won for his pioneering work on an observatory that detects particles from space.

breaking_news.headline: Lawyer for one of Cornell 7 calls for special prosecutor to be removed over previous comments
breaking_news.summary: New York Attorney General Letitia James is investigating the rape allegations, but the lawyer says comments she made on the case should disqualify her.

breaking_news.headline: White House defends Trump comment to let Iran 'take out' LA and San Diego
breaking_news.summary: Gavin Newsom called the remarks "deranged", but the White House said Trump was warning of the risk of a nuclear Iran.

breaking_news.headline: Ship sinks and crew missing after Black Sea drone attack
breaking_news.summary: It is not clear who is behind the attacks which come as Russia intensifies strikes in the Black Sea as part of its war against Ukraine.

breaking_news.headline: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
breaking_news.summary: August Hanning is accused of obtaining classified information for a foreign power.

breaking_news.headline: Five reasons India's stock market is sinking even when its economy is growing
breaking_news.summary: The world's fastest growing major economy has one of the worst performing major equity markets in 2026.

breaking_news.headline: Last call for the mall? How shopping centres are reinventing themselves
breaking_news.summary: In the internet age, medium-sized retail hubs are looking for new ways to survive and thrive.

breaking_news.headline: OpenAI admits response to Australian government hacks 'not good enough'
breaking_news.summary: Top executive Jason Kwon tells hearing company has added "more precautions" to its training environments.

breaking_news.headline: Lego fraudster among last year's most high-profile insurance scammers
breaking_news.summary: The person was sentenced to 28 months in prison after an investigation found the claims were made up, the insurance trade body, the ABI said.
